title: US chip, memory, and storage stocks fell sharply on Thursday, with Sandisk down 13%, Seagate 10%, Western Digital 9%, and Intel and Micron 6% each (George Steer/Financial Times)
summary: George Steer / Financial Times: US chip, memory, and storage stocks fell sharply on Thursday, with Sandisk down 13%, Seagate 10%, Western Digital 9%, and Intel and Micron 6% each — Investors pull away from shares in companies that have led markets higher this year — US tech stocks fell sharply on Thursday …
contentText:
George Steer / Financial Times :

US chip, memory, and storage stocks fell sharply on Thursday, with Sandisk down 13%, Seagate 10%, Western Digital 9%, and Intel and Micron 6% each   —  Investors pull away from shares in companies that have led markets higher this year  —  US tech stocks fell sharply on Thursday …
